name: Jacob Helberg

summary.text: Jacob Helberg is Under Secretary of State for Economic Growth, Energy, and the Environment. President-elect Trump announced his nomination in December 2024; Senator Bill Hagerty introduced him at his Senate Foreign Relations Committee hearing on June 10, 2025. Before government service Helberg was a senior adviser to Palantir chief executive Alex Karp and co-founded the Hill & Valley Forum, a gathering of lawmakers and technology investors. His 2025 financial disclosure listed Palantir stock worth between $100,001 and $250,000, which his ethics agreement pledged to divest within 90 days of confirmation.

openQuestions: Helberg is in the site's approved web data (as Keith Rabois's husband, nominated Under Secretary with a June 10, 2025 hearing) but not in the page entity index. The hearing is supported by Hagerty's release and the committee testimony; the family relationship was not re-sourced here.
The date Helberg assumed office (October 16, 2025) and his prior service on the U.S.-China Economic and Security Review Commission appeared only in Wikipedia and were not recorded.

Sources give the post's title differently ('Economic Growth, Energy, and the Environment' per Hagerty and Trump's announcement; 'Economic Affairs' per Wikipedia); an official State Department biography was not among the pages returned.
Hill & Valley's first convening (reported as March 2023) and its third co-founder Delian Asparouhov were named only in Wikipedia.
